Processing script data/paraguay_2021_mobility.do, Bookmark 1: mobility.
note: mapping_basis=data_labels: the .do keeps the 13 Hábito.csv column names verbatim as item (gen item = "`var'"; core model s3 pattern 1, no rename). The CSV carries no variable labels, but its column headers are self-describing and tie code to text: each names its own P708 row (IdCalifFrecuencia=Frecuencia, IdCalifPrecioCalidad=Precio en función de calidad recibida, IdCalifFacilidadSubidaBajada=Facilidad para subir y bajar del bus, IdCalifInformacionDisp=Información disponible sobre el sistema, IdCalifParadasBuses=Paradas de buses (refugio e información), etc.), 13/13 unambiguous, and the 13 columns sit in Hábito.csv positions 31-43 in exactly the questionnaire's row order. RESP: the .do sets 5 (No sabe) and 99 (undocumented, one each on TiempoViaje, AtencionChofer, FacilidadSubidaBajada, ParadasBuses) to missing and applies NO reversal or recode, so live 1=Muy malo, 2=Malo, 3=Bueno, 4=Muy bueno, as printed in the questionnaire grid header (Muy malo (1) Malo (2) Bueno (3) Muy bueno (4) No sabe (5)). Route 9: raw Hábito.csv counts for codes 1-4 equal live item x resp counts in 52/52 cells (e.g. IdCalifFrecuencia 84/329/443/46; IdCalifAtencionChofer 18/157/677/50; IdCalifInformacionDisp 82/366/364/15; IdCalifParadasBuses 150/435/290/15); per-item n (827-909) equals irw_table_sets() server-side per-item n; 11669 rows. No sabe counts dropped: 3-85 per item (85 on InformacionDisp, 21 on ParadasBuses). TEXT (text_source=study_materials): instructions = the 708 stem as printed in the questionnaire, minus the interviewer note '(USAR TARJETA N°2)'; it names the No sabe option, which respondents were offered but which the .do drops, so no No sabe row ships. The showcard (manual p.80) prints the same stem with a final period and the same 13 rows. item_text = the questionnaire's grid rows verbatim (line wrap in the last row joined). option_text = the grid column headers (Muy malo / Malo / Bueno / Muy bueno), casing per the grid rather than the stem's 'Muy Malo ... Muy Bueno'. Note P707 prints 'Distancia a la parada' where P708 prints 'Distancia de la parada'; the P708 form ships. Single section_id, no section_prompt. language=Spanish; translation_source=machine_translation: INE publishes the AMA 2021 in Spanish only; English produced by IRW (Atención del chofer rendered Driver's service; Modo de conducción rendered Driving style). Issues-page entry owed once live. STEP 3b: dictionary Description (ratings of the bus system on frequency, punctuality, price, comfort, cleanliness, driving and stops) and the .do comment match P708; 13 live items = 13 grid rows, 4-level resp = the four substantive grid columns. The P707 importance ranking (same 12 aspects plus Otro) is a different question and not in this table. RIGHTS: originator INE Paraguay (own survey items, no upstream instrument cited). Licence page: 'Esta licencia otorga la autorización gratuita, perpetua y no exclusiva de uso y/o transformación de la información y los datos abiertos públicos propiedad del Estado Paraguayo' covering 'copia, extracción, reproducción, distribución, comunicación pública, adaptación, transformación'; conditions are citing the source and update date and 'No usar la información pública ni los datos abiertos públicos de forma que sugiera o simule un uso oficial o patrocinado por el Estado Paraguayo'. Attribution and a no-endorsement condition reserve no use right, so no block; no instrument_rights_register.csv row exists and none written.
public_note: The English wording for this table was produced by IRW, not by INE Paraguay, which publishes the AMA 2021 mobility survey in Spanish only; the No sabe (don't know) option named in the instructions was offered to respondents but is recoded to missing in the response data.
